Entity: Scalenut / AI Visibility and GEO Platforms
Friction: Scalenut's whole pricing page has re-pointed at GEO and AI visibility, and its headline offer is 60% off annual plans with doubled limits. Buyers compare the discounted sticker against competitors' list prices, so they never notice that the promotion cuts unit cost far more than it cuts price — and that its expiry raises unit cost by roughly five times, not the 2.5 times the price alone suggests.
Logic: Two arithmetic moves settle this category. First, price the promotion properly: Scalenut Starter is $59 for 5 articles ($11.80 each) at list, $24 for 10 ($2.40 each) on the promo — a 4.9x unit-cost swing, where the headline discount reads as only 60%. Second, normalize the feature everyone now sells: tracked prompts cost $5.90 each at Scalenut Starter list, $1.99 at its Professional tier, $2.58 at Clearscope Essentials, $1.33 at Clearscope Business, $4.76 inside Surfer Standard and $1.85 on Surfer's standalone analytics plan, $4.60 at NeuronWriter Bronze with a $0.90 add-on rate — a spread of more than six times between the cheapest and dearest rate for a line item that looks identical on every pricing page. Frase tiers by model coverage rather than prompt count, which is a third structure again. We are not an alternative: audit-only, no generation and no prompt tracking.
content_angle: Prices the promotion the way a renewal will: Scalenut's 60%-off annual offer with doubled limits is a 4.9x unit-cost advantage that reverses on expiry. Then normalizes tracked prompts — the feature every vendor in the category now sells — to a per-prompt monthly rate, exposing a spread over six times wide behind identical-looking line items. Every figure first-party with a verification date. Names our own position: audit-only, no prompt tracking of any kind.
